parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under an Examples/ directory — a canonical sample-app location. The canonical implementation already exists in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel). The WallpaperSampleApp copy is almost certainly a self-contained debug convenience duplicated intentionally so the sample app has no hard dependency on the DebugPanel package. Consolidating it would couple a sample/example target to a production shared package, which is typically undesirable.
